title: The magic dice
summary: A dice that lands on a random number every time you roll it.
done: Your magic dice is ready! The “random” block is useful in lots of games: drawing a card, picking who starts…

welcome.text: What if your phone became a dice? Let’s build a dice that lands on a **random** number from 1 to 6.

add-text.text: Put a **Text** on the screen: it will show the number of the dice.

big-text.text: A dice should be easy to read! Make the text bigger with its **text size**, for example 80.

add-button.text: Add a **Button** to roll the dice.

button-text.text: Write “Roll the dice” in the button’s **text**.

go-blocks.text: Now for the blocks: open the **Blocks** tab.

event-block.text: In **{{Button}}**, take the [when {{Button}} is clicked] block and drop it in the middle.

set-block.text: In **{{Text}}**, take [set text of {{Text}} to] and snap it inside the “when…” block.

random.text: In **Math**, take the [random integer from 1 to 6] block and drop it on the white box of the “set” block.
random.hint: It replaces the white box: let go right on top of it.

roll.text: Roll your dice in the preview: tap the button three times. Does the number change each time?
